info.mix: Scooped at 1 kHz already: it leaves the middle to vocals and guitars

info.role: Slowly rising, flanging pad that builds unease over six seconds
info.playing: Hold one chord across a build; retrigger to restart the rise
info.mix: It rises on its own: automate TONE down to hold it back, or MOTION 0 for a flat bed

info.role: Glassy key-pad: a soft strike that blooms into a sustained glow
info.genres: Ambient pop, lo-fi, piano-led film cues
info.playing: Arpeggiated chords or held voicings
info.mix: Pairs with a real piano: pan them apart and let this fill the sustain

info.role: Submerged, muffled pad with a slow comb shimmer
info.genres: Deep ambient, dub techno, underwater cues
info.playing: Long chords; dub-style chord stabs with SPACE up
info.mix: Almost no top end: it can be loud without masking anything above 1 kHz

info.role: Punchy, tuned electronic kick with a clean click
info.register: Tune to the song's key around C1–G1
info.playing: Play one note per hit; the note you play sets the tuning
info.mix: MOTION is the pitch-drop depth (punch), TONE the click; keep the bass out of its 50–70 Hz or sidechain it

info.role: Long, round sub kick with a soft attack
info.genres: Deep techno, dub techno, trap, ambient techno
info.playing: Quarter notes, or sparse hits with room to ring
info.mix: It rings long: this is the bass in sparse tracks. Shorter release by playing shorter notes

info.role: Overdriven industrial kick: hard, but still tuned and punchy
info.genres: Industrial techno, hard techno, EBM, trap metal
info.playing: Four-on-the-floor or broken patterns
info.mix: Already distorted: it takes the place of a clean kick, not a layer; GRIT takes it further

info.role: Tight synthetic snare: a tuned body under a bright crack
info.playing: Backbeats and ghost notes at low velocity
info.mix: The crack sits at 2–3 kHz; SPACE for a bigger room, TONE to darken it under a vocal

info.role: Three-strike hand clap with a rough edge
info.playing: Backbeats; layer with a snare
info.mix: MOTION gives each clap a slightly different colour, like real hands

info.role: Short woody rimshot click
info.playing: Syncopated clicks and off-beats
info.mix: Tiny and bright: it cuts through at low level

info.role: Closed metallic hat; harder hits ring a little longer
info.playing: 8ths and 16ths with velocity accents
info.mix: MOTION varies each hit so rolls sound played, not looped

info.role: Open metallic hat that the next closed hit chokes (mono voice)
info.playing: Off-beat opens; play STEEL HAT on the same track to choke it
info.mix: Mono by design: any new note cuts the ring, like a real hi-hat pedal

info.role: Soft grainy shaker with a swell on each hit
info.playing: 16ths with accents on the off-beats
info.mix: Sits under hats; MOTION humanizes every hit

info.role: Tuned synth tom: play it melodically across an octave
info.playing: Fills down the keyboard; tuned to the note
info.mix: MOTION is the pitch bend on each hit; tune fills to the key

info.role: Metal-on-metal strike, inharmonic and bright
info.playing: Accents on 2 and 4, or sparse hits in a groove
info.mix: Inharmonic by design, so it never clashes with the key; keep it sparse

info.role: Electronic zap: a fast downward sweep
info.playing: Fills and accents; pitch it for melodic zaps
info.mix: MOTION sets the sweep depth; short enough to sit between any drums

info.role: Classic filter-envelope saw pluck for chords and arpeggios
info.playing: 16th arpeggios and off-beat chords
info.mix: TONE also lengthens the pluck; the dotted echo sits right at 110–128 BPM

info.role: A plucked string made from a noise burst and a tuned comb
info.playing: Arpeggios and picked melodies; soft velocity for a nylon feel
info.mix: Physical and dry: SPACE for size, TONE for how bright the pick is

info.role: Metallic, slightly inharmonic pluck like struck copper
info.playing: Sparse figures; accents ring harder
info.mix: Keep lines simple so the inharmonic ring stays musical

info.role: Clean glass pluck with a ping-pong echo
info.genres: Future garage, ambient pop, lo-fi, film
info.playing: Sparse melodies and 8th-note figures
info.mix: Very little below 300 Hz: it floats over any mix; SPACE sets the echo

info.role: Synthetic harp: bright pluck, long soft ring
info.playing: Glissandos and broken chords
info.mix: Lets ring: in a dense track, TONE down and SPACE down

info.role: Thumb-piano pluck with a metallic tine click
info.genres: Afro-house, organic house, lo-fi, children's score
info.playing: Syncopated ostinatos
info.mix: The click is 2–4 kHz: under a busy hi-hat, pull TONE down a notch

info.role: Warm wooden mallet, marimba-adjacent
info.playing: Syncopated patterns and rolls
info.mix: Short and dry: it can sit loud; MOTION varies each hit slightly for a played feel

info.role: Soft, dark plucked string with a nylon-like thumb attack
info.playing: Fingerpicked chords and melodies at modest velocity
info.mix: Dark by design: it sits under a vocal like an acoustic guitar would

info.role: Wide supersaw pluck for chord stabs
info.playing: Chord stabs on the grid
info.mix: Wide top, clean bottom (HP 200 Hz). MOTION adds a 1/4 pump from each note

info.role: Chiptune pluck; MOTION randomizes the pulse width per note
info.playing: Fast arpeggios
info.mix: The top is already shelved down: still, keep it under the lead in level

info.role: Distorted, rusty-string pluck with a metal pick
info.playing: Muted riffs and repeated notes
info.mix: Already driven: sit it like a distorted guitar, 2–4 kHz forward, lows cut

info.role: Short, palm-muted synth pluck
info.playing: Off-beat patterns and 8ths
info.mix: Tiny and dry: great doubled with a bass line an octave up

info.role: Synthetic pizzicato string section
info.playing: Ostinatos and staccato chords
info.mix: Plays the role of real pizz in a mockup: add SPACE for the hall, keep it dry for pop

info.role: Digital pluck where each note lands on a different timbre
info.genres: IDM, glitch, ambient techno, game UI
info.playing: Fast 16ths and random-feeling arpeggios
info.mix: MOTION sets how different each note is; at 0 every note matches

info.role: Bright FM chime with a long, clean ring
info.playing: Sparse high notes
info.mix: Rings long: leave space after each note or shorten with a lower TONE

info.role: Hollow square pluck with a moving notch
info.playing: Arpeggios and riffs
info.mix: Its notch leaves the vocal band open; MOTION moves the notch

info.role: Rising 1/16 saw arpeggio over two octaves with a squelchy filter
info.playing: Hold three- or four-note chords, a bar each
info.mix: The filter climbs over two bars at default MOTION; pull MOTION to 0 for a steady line under a vocal

info.role: Falling pulse-wave 1/16 arpeggio, hollow and nasal
info.playing: Hold chords; the notes fall from the top of the chord
info.mix: Pulse width moves once a bar; MOTION 0 fixes it. Cut 2–3 kHz a touch if it fights a vocal

info.role: Glass bells climbing and falling across three octaves in eighths
info.playing: Hold small chords low; three octaves climb fast
info.mix: The top octave gets bright: TONE down or play lower if it pokes above the hats

info.role: Dotted-eighth arpeggio that rolls across the bar line against a straight beat
info.playing: Hold chords for a bar or two; the 3-against-4 does the work
info.mix: The filter opens across each bar; MOTION 0 stops it. Keep the delay short so the dots stay clear

info.role: Downsampled digital arpeggio with a stepped timbre per eighth
info.playing: Play the chord a note at a time, in the order you want it
info.mix: The timbre jumps in time with the song, not at random rates; MOTION 0 holds one tone. GRIT crunches it further

info.role: Supersaw 1/16 arpeggio that opens and spreads over two bars
info.playing: Hold chords on the downbeat
info.mix: Sidechain it to the kick for the classic pump. MOTION 0 stops the sweep; high-pass it higher under a busy top line

info.role: Whole-chord bell stabs in eighths, jumping an octave every other hit
info.playing: Hold chords; each hit plays the whole chord
info.mix: Chords are dense: voice them in three notes. The bell tone moves over two bars; MOTION 0 fixes it

info.role: Wavefolded eighth-note arpeggio walking down two octaves
info.playing: Hold minor chords for a bar
info.mix: The fold grows and shrinks each bar; MOTION 0 holds it. It's mid-heavy, so carve 400 Hz if the mix clouds

info.role: Fast 1/32 shimmer: the chord blurs into a bright metallic ripple
info.playing: Hold chords under a slower part; it reads as texture, not notes
info.mix: Sits above the hats; TONE down or high-shelf it if it crowds the cymbals

info.role: Slow quarter-note arpeggio of breathy voices, somewhere between a pad and a melody
info.playing: Hold chords for a bar or more
info.mix: Long release overlaps the notes into a pad; shorten SPACE if it smears the downbeat

info.role: Swung, dusty 1/16 arpeggio with slight tape wobble
info.genres: Lo-fi hip-hop, downtempo, UK garage, bedroom pop
info.playing: Play chords note by note in the order you want them
info.mix: The wobble is gentle and MOTION 0 removes it. Swing is 30%; set your drums to match

info.role: Steely harp runs up three octaves in sixteenths
info.playing: Hold small chords low
info.mix: A three-octave run covers a lot of range: hold two- or three-note chords and TONE down if the top gets glassy

info.role: Vowel-filtered notes in a random order, each with its own mouth shape
info.playing: Hold a chord; only its own notes play, in a random order
info.mix: The random order stays inside your chord and the vowel steps in time. MOTION 0 fixes the vowel

info.role: Rolling 1/16 bass arpeggio: root, third and fifth under the chord
info.playing: Hold two- or three-note shapes in the bass register
info.mix: Dry and mono in the lows; sidechain it to the kick, or play only the root for a plain rolling bass

info.role: Short chord stabs repeating in swung sixteenths
info.genres: Industrial techno, breaks, electro, drum and bass
info.playing: Hold chords; the whole chord stutters
info.mix: Each beat opens the filter and lets it fall; MOTION 0 leaves flat stabs. Voice chords narrow so the stabs stay tight

info.role: Organ and voices cycling in eighths, like a machine playing a hymn
info.playing: Hold chords for a bar; minor chords suit it
info.mix: The organ octave swells over two bars; MOTION 0 fixes it. Trim SPACE when the arrangement gets dense
